∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw) (s : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.State q),
  s.iteration < outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.rounds q →
    (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.advance q s).iteration = s.iteration + 1 ∧
      (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.advance q s).clock = s.clock ∧
        (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.advance q s).x = s.x - q.η • s.g ∧
          (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.advance q s).g = s.g ∧
            ∀ (i : Fin q.n) (job : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Job q.d q.m),
              outputs.Proofs.FreyaExecution.pendingJobs q (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.advance q s) i = some job →
                job.started = s.clock ∧ s.nextID ≤ job.id ∧ job.id < s.nextID + q.n
